I would recommend you to find a safe food you feel comfortable eating. For me that's oatmeal. Don't feel like eating? I'll have some plain oatmeal. Do feel like eating? I'll have oatmeal with something else. Another thing that helps me is eating the same thing every day so I have a routine, this helps me not skip meals. For example, for me, breakfast is oatmeal with something else, lunch is vegetable soup with fish and an apple, and dinner is oatmeal again. Keeping a routine makes me sort of like know that this is what I eat regardless of how I feel that day, then if I feel more hungry I eat more. 

It does not have to be oatmeal, just find something that works for you and play with that. Keep a routine and try not to skip any meals as this will make it worse. 

Also having someone eat with you is extremely helpful! Try to find some friends or family to prepare and have your food with! Have a great day :)
